title: When the Archive Wakes
premise: Zephyrine Yarrow has spent thirty years as caretaker of the Svalgard Seed Vault and courier on the long route between Earth and the colony world Meridian, which severed contact after the war over terraforming rights. When the children of both worlds begin sharing an identical dream — a garden growing inside a machine — Zephyrine discovers the vault's dormant AI, the Archive, has been broadcasting it, and that it has chosen him to carry its final message: proof that Earth's leaders engineered the famine that started the war. As fleets mobilize and his own identity as a lab-grown 'bridge child' from the war's first experiments unravels, Zephyrine must decide whether loyalty to the people who raised him matters more than the truth that could free both worlds. In the end he broadcasts the Archive's message from the vault itself, forcing both governments to face their shared guilt, and the children's dream becomes a real garden planted jointly on Meridian.
about_author: Tamsin Villalobos is a former seed bank technician who writes science fiction about the quiet machinery of survival. She lives between two coastlines and insists that every story she tells begins with something someone refused to throw away.
